character_facts: The visible operator is heavily cybernetic, with mechanical implants around the head and body.
The operator speaks in a commanding, alarmed tone during battle.
A subordinate obeys maneuver orders immediately.
Lothar is feared and described as overwhelmingly powerful even when only represented indirectly.
characters_present: A bald cybernetic operator or commander
A subordinate pilot/crew member addressed as 'master' or receiving orders
Lothar (mentioned, represented here as a holographic or projected attacking form)
continuity_links: This page depicts an ongoing battle already in progress, with the destruction of the Cerebomaks reported as a recent event.
The mention of Lothar as a hologram implies prior context about the real Lothar and why only a projection is present.
The final encouragement about having another trick suggests the attacked crew may attempt a new tactic on the following page.
dialogue_meaning: The crew is under immediate attack and attempts evasive action plus a counterattack.
They are shocked by how quickly the attacker destroyed the Cerebomaks.
They believe the attacker on this page is not the real Lothar but a holographic manifestation.
Even as they insult or underestimate their own side, they admit the real Lothar would be vastly stronger.
The crew reports that the entity's tentacles are physically fouling their weapons systems.
The operator urges ingenuity under pressure, telling the other character to remember a 'good conjurer' always has another trick.
locations: Interior command area of a ship or machine
Industrial/mechanical zone filled with massive pipes or conduits
lore_facts: There are entities or units called 'Cerebomaks.'
Lothar can appear or act through a hologram/projection powerful enough to destroy multiple foes.
The real Lothar is said to be far stronger than the projection seen here.
The attacking form has tentacle-like or bandage-like appendages that can interfere with machinery.
The ship or machine under attack has firing tubes that can be obstructed.
plot_events: A cybernetic subordinate orders evasive maneuvers and a 'whirlwind' attack against an oncoming energy entity.
The speaker reports that the being has destroyed all the 'Cerebomaks' in under a minute.
The speaker says the attacker is only a 'hologram' of Lothar, implying the real one would be even more powerful.
The glowing being extends tentacles or appendages toward a black ship.
Its slimy appendages obstruct the ship's firing tubes, preventing effective attack.
The ship moves through or alongside a dense field of giant pipes or machinery while the crew continues reacting.
uncertainties: Several speech balloons are difficult to read exactly because of image resolution and glare; wording may be approximate.
The exact spelling or identity of terms like 'Cerebomaks' and the attacked ship's name may be uncertain due to small text.
It is unclear whether the glowing attacker is literally a hologram, an energy creature, or both; the page only reports it as Lothar's hologram.
The precise identities of the cybernetic speaker and subordinate are not given clearly on this page alone.
visual_summary: A cybernetic operator aboard a large machine or ship reacts as a blazing, tentacled energy-being attacks in space. Bright white-blue blasts wipe through mechanical enemies, then the creature stretches long tendrils around a sleek black craft and clogs its weapon tubes. In the final panels, the craft dives among giant golden pipes or industrial structures while the operator keeps talking over comms.
